included: A runtime subset of the official archify/ core: CLI, schemas, renderers, viewer assets, references, runtime scripts, migrations, delta, recipes, brand metadata, bundled explainer dependencies and thirteen doctor proof fixtures. Upstream skill instructions, tests and generated example output artifacts are omitted.
updatePolicy: Update deliberately from the upstream repository; keep the vendored CLI offline by setting ARCHIFY_UPDATE_CHECK_DISABLED=1.

localModifications.assets/template.html: Joyally semantic palettes replace all four presets in light and dark mode. Source: assets/joyally-diagram.tokens.json diagram. Geometry and export workflow preserved.
localModifications.verification: Standalone resources: node ../../scripts/joyally-diagram.mjs doctor from runtime/diagram. Repository parity with optional Joyally Design tokens: python3 skills/design/joyally-design/scripts/validate-diagram-theme.py from the repository root.
localModifications.presentation: Joyally Image branding for viewer, explainers, comparison, preview, evidence and CLI. Preserve upstream identity in licenses, provenance, compatibility internals and distributed notice text; preserve protocol keys, machine-readable receipts and schemas.
localModifications.explainer/reader.css: All clean/editorial/product/swiss themes, system dark fallback and print share Joyally diagram colors via readerMapping.
